failure_summary.description: A newly supplied neighborhood, hotel criterion, or named attraction was treated as already satisfied by cache or did not trigger the requested update.
Generated flight, attraction, or nearest-search results were not saved to cache.
Agents omitted requested trip domains or legs, asked for dates already established by the itinerary, or requested an unmentioned hotel domain.
An unavailable tool name was called, or a state abbreviation was mapped to the city field instead of the state field.

patch.reasoning: The common failures are already addressed by the skill's guidance on follow-up updates, cache compatibility and saving, itinerary dates and legs, requested-domain scope, exact tool use, and location-field mapping. Adding similar rules would duplicate existing guidance; prior attempts to reinforce these instructions regressed, so no edit is warranted.
